basics.name: ZHANG Xinyi
basics.label: Postdoctoral Fellow
basics.summary: Postdoctoral Fellow in the Department of Computer Science at Hong Kong Baptist University, with experience in designing and implementing high-performance, secure database systems and distribution-aware data structures.

work.name: Hong Kong Baptist University
highlights: Research on efficient and secure query processing for relational and vector databases.

work.name: Nanyang Technological University
highlights: Worked on "Learned Indexes for Query Optimization", integrating learned index structures into structure-guided execution plans for acyclic queries.

work.name: Hong Kong Baptist University
highlights: Designed novel algorithms and indexes for relational and vector databases to support efficient and secure query processing in a wide range of systems.
Designed novel distribution-aware data structures to handle complex database workloads while ensuring robust performance.
Research resulted in publications at top-tier conferences.

work.name: ByteDance
highlights: Optimized the inter-cluster communication for internal database clusters of ByteDance to enhance throughput and reduce latency.

work.name: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
highlights: Designed a fast consensus algorithm for blockchain combining SDN, dPOS and PBFT consensus algorithms.
Built a practical blockchain system for ASTRI as an integrity-assured record for their public distributed database.

projects.name: FedKNN: Secure Federated k-Nearest Neighbor Search (SIGMOD '24)
projects.summary: A system for secure and privacy-preserving federated kNN search, achieving up to 4.8× efficiency improvement over SOTA by optimizing local computations with a distribution-aware algorithm.
highlights: Up to 4.8× efficiency improvement over SOTA

projects.name: HIRE: A Hybrid Learned Index for Robust and Efficient Performance (SIGMOD '26)
projects.summary: A hybrid in-memory index combining learned predictions with traditional robustness, which reduces tail latency by 98% and improves throughput by 41.7× compared to SOTA approaches.

projects.name: Privacy-Preserving Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (Under Review)
projects.summary: A secure ANN index structure within trusted execution environments, mitigating side-channel attacks by enforcing oblivious memory access patterns on proximity graph indexes. Achieves plaintext-level throughput with provable privacy guarantees via a distribution-aware oblivious access algorithm.

projects.name: Authenticated Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (Under Revision, SIGMOD)
projects.summary: VIDA, a novel scheme for authenticated graph-based ANN search that leverages vector commitments and Inner Product Arguments to verify distance computations, drastically reducing the overall data transmission size. MeST, a proof aggregation mechanism, compresses the verification of multiple vectors into a single cryptographic proof. Up to 5.2× speedup in end-to-end latency and 99.3% reduction in data transfer time.
highlights: Up to 5.2× end-to-end speedup; 99.3% data-transfer reduction
